active_set_rule_declared.rationale: P33/P35 A03 fallback: either tier below the 10-cluster training floor collapses the arm to the incumbent for that fold, fold UNEVALUABLE, identically arm and null (ACTIVE_SET_RULE_PREREGISTRATION.json sha256 327fa8ec9fb54e3635ae70b540573b4121c6136fc5034cbdb689cabbe2986db7). This ActiveSetRule instance expresses the SHALLOW-tier half of that rule -- the half the generic P27 mechanism can see, because SHALLOW is the only declared design column; the DEEP-tier half is evaluated separately by tier_symmetry_check (see module docstring).
